thread.document:
Our Website: https://eecs182-ec-a-red.netlify.app/
GitHub: https://github.com/begriff/cs182-ec-a
Group Members: Jason Trinh, Justin Yang, Etaash Patel, Kevin Tseng

We built a lightweight pipeline + static website to collect, organize, and explore EECS 182 “Special Participation A” Ed posts. The core workflow is: (1) collect discussion threads + attachments, (2) clean/structure the data into a consistent dataset with basic metrics, and (3) present everything in an interactive browser UI so users can browse patterns across homeworks and models.

On the website, the main experience is an “Explore” view where users can filter by homework/model, search by keywords, and sort posts to quickly find relevant submissions. Clicking a post opens a detailed view for reading the full content. The site also supports optional AI-generated insights that summarize trends by homework and by model, and an optional in-browser AI assistant to help answer questions—designed to keep the tool easy to run locally without needing a backend.
